info.title: Shongre API
info.summary: The one authoritative public HTTP contract for every Shongre client.
info.description: OpenAPI-first contract for Web, iOS, Android, administration, and approved integrations. The versioned server base is /api/v1. Generated artifacts are read-only; changes begin in this file.

CookieAuth.name: shongre_access
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly Web session cookie. Unsafe methods also require the double-submit CSRF header.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Caller correlation id. The server returns the accepted or generated value.

MarketContext.name: X-Shongre-Market
MarketContext.description: Resolved Web market (ISO alpha-2). It is checked against route/query/body context but is never used as an authorization credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Strongly recommended for retryable financial and import mutations. Reusing a key with a different payload is a conflict.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description: Required for privileged catalog mutations. Reusing a key with a different operation or payload is a conflict.

monthlyRevenue.description: Legacy major-unit aggregate, without currency. Retained for v1 compatibility; display clients must use revenueByCurrency. Removal requires v2.

monthlyViews.description: Cumulative views of the bounded catalogue sample, not a monthly audience series.

conversionRate.description: Completed current-month sales divided by cumulative sampled catalogue views, times 100; not an event-cohort conversion rate.

Capability.description: Canonical Shongre capability identifier from packages/contracts/src/access-control.ts.

AutoFavoriteCollection.description: Vehicle identifiers saved by the caller in the resolved market.

EducationFavoriteCollection.description: Tutor identifiers saved by the caller in the resolved market.

EmploymentFavoriteCollection.description: Job identifiers saved by the caller in the resolved market.

FavoriteCollection.description: Listing identifiers and their public card projections saved by the caller in the resolved market.

FavoriteSetRequest.description: The exact favorite state the caller wants; retries are idempotent.

JsonValue.description: A JSON-compatible payload whose domain representation is mapped by the owning service adapter.

PublicSellerProfile.description: Public seller facts safe for marketplace discovery. Authentication, contact and Staff fields are excluded.

ListingMarketPublication.description: Market-scoped availability and price evidence retained on a public listing.

presentation.description: How the value should be shown. 'feature' marks a capability the listing has (an affirmative boolean), which surfaces as a labelled amenity rather than a label/value row. Absent means 'fact'.

PublicListing.description: Public marketplace listing projection after private seller, entitlement, provider and risk fields are removed.

price.description: Legacy major-unit listing amount. Client adapters convert this value to integer minor units at their transport boundary.

promotionSource.description: Verified promotion evidence kind for the resolved market publication.

promotionSourceId.description: Opaque public proof identifier; never an order, entitlement, or administrator grant identifier.

locationPrecision.description: How precise `latitude`/`longitude` are. `exact` is the coordinate the row carries; `city` was resolved from the town name and must be rendered at town scale, never as an address. Absent means no coordinate is published and no map should be drawn.

PublicListingCardsRequest.description: A bounded set of unique listing identifiers to hydrate in the resolved market.

PublicSitemapListingPage.description: Stable cursor page used by the Web server to build canonical market sitemaps.

totalRelation.description: Whether total is exact or a lower bound imposed by the bounded candidate window.

snapshotAt.description: Stable discovery snapshot shared by every page in the cursor chain.

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometres around the supplied centre.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search centre. Travels with longitude.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search centre. Travels with latitude.

north.description: Edge of the visible map. All four are required together.

south.description: Edge of the visible map. All four are required together.

east.description: Edge of the visible map. All four are required together.

west.description: Edge of the visible map. All four are required together.

TaxonomyV1LocalizedLabels.description: Localized domain labels keyed by BCP 47 locale. French is always present.

TaxonomyV1LocalizedShortLabels.description: Localized compact category labels keyed by BCP 47 locale. French is always present and each value is limited to 28 characters.

links.description: Market-managed navigation destinations rendered in the same ordered rail as taxonomy categories. Absent means no additional links.
Replaces the market-managed navigation links in the same revisioned transaction. Omission preserves the stored links for existing clients.

TaxonomyV1CategorySummary.description: Compatibility projection retained while v3 consumers migrate to taxonomy v1.

userId.description: Ignored for unauthenticated ingestion; the server derives authenticated identity.

canonicalDomainMode.description: Stable routing mode. Concrete hostnames are supplied by deployment configuration.

ReportInput.description: Exactly one of listingId, reportedUserId, or deliveryRequestId is required.

DeliveryFavoriteCollection.description: Delivery request identifiers saved by the caller in the resolved market.

DiscoveryCollection.description: A taxonomy root with the inventory facts a discovery rail needs.

DiscoveryCollectionPage.description: Bounded, market-scoped collection rail for the resolved market.

taxonomyRevision.description: Publication revision the collection set is bound to.

PublicMapConfig.description: Map configuration a browser or device is allowed to hold. Deliberately excludes the geocoding endpoint and the operator contact identity.

attribution.description: Required by the tile and data licences. Must remain visible.

AccountDataExport.description: A portable copy of everything the account owns, as required by data-portability rules. Contains only the requester's own records; counterparties appear as identifiers, never as profiles.

truncated.description: Sections whose export hit the per-section bound. Absent when the copy is complete.

OrderReturn.description: A buyer return request and the seller decision on it.

isStatutoryWithdrawal.description: A statutory withdrawal cannot be refused by the seller.

refundIssued.description: Whether the provider refund settled immediately.

x-shongre-contract.compatibilityPolicy: Additive changes remain in v1. Breaking changes require a new major server base and a published migration window.
x-shongre-contract.deprecationPolicy: Deprecated operations declare deprecated=true and sunset metadata, have an owner and removal issue, and are removed only after every repository consumer migrates.
